installLicensePanel.heading: Four steps. Your prompts never touch our servers.
installLicensePanel.step1: 1 · Get your license key — the SDK is public but fail-closed; it only runs with a valid key. Passed as licenseKey.
installLicensePanel.step2: 2 · Create & verify a service-account key — a machine credential (bvk_…) so the SDK reports counts-only usage (your seats & savings). Separate from the license key; only its hash is stored. Create one, then Test my key to confirm it's live.
installLicensePanel.shownOnce: shown once at creation — only the prefix is stored.
installLicensePanel.step3: 3 · Install — public on npm, no token, no config.
installLicensePanel.step4: 4 · Wire your provider & read the SavingsReport
installLicensePanel.finalNote: That's it. No valid license → generate() refuses. If your plan is cancelled the SDK stops within ~15 min via licenseServerUrl — no restart, and it never bricks your production if we're unreachable.

hero.title: Prove the savings on
hero.lede: BV‑SALA sits in front of any LLM provider and, for every request, picks the cheapest execution that still meets your quality bar. Don't take our word for it — paste your data below and watch the meter move.
hero.note: Runs entirely in your browser. No signup, nothing leaves this page.

step1.eyebrow: Step 1 · Preliminary tests — in your browser
step1.title: Try the optimizer yourself. Nothing leaves this page.
step1.body: These two instruments run the real optimizer locally so you can sanity-check the mechanism before touching a provider. The left panel runs the real BV‑SALA optimizer on data you paste — real token accounting, the same code the SDK ships. The right panel estimates a monthly bill by running the optimizer over a sample workload against a mock model. For provably-measured dollars, see Step 2 below.

step2.title: Real savings, measured against a real provider. Both arms.
step2.body: This is the output of the A/B benchmark (pnpm ab): for every scenario it sends a naive request and the BV‑SALA request to the same model, prices both from the provider's own token usage, and reports the 95% confidence lower bound — never the flattering point estimate. Nothing is modeled.

ledgersHead.title: Four separate ledgers. Never summed into one vanity number.
ledgersHead.body: A cache hit removes a whole call. BV‑SALA re‑encodes structured data more compactly. Compression drops redundant words. A provider prefix cache makes tokens cheaper without removing them. Mixing them lies to you — so we don't.

ledgers.name: avoided_calls
ledgers.desc: LLM, retrieval and tool calls that never executed at all.

ledgers.name: eliminated_tokens
ledgers.desc: Information dropped because it simply wasn't needed.

ledgers.name: compressed_tokens
ledgers.desc: Information kept, but encoded with fewer tokens.

ledgers.name: provider_cached_tokens
ledgers.desc: Still in the prompt, but billed or processed more cheaply.

pricing.title: Pennies to run. Multiples to save.
pricing.body: No free tier, no trial — test BV‑SALA right here in your browser, then subscribe to run it in your app. Priced per seat, in USD.
pricing.proNote: PRO — billed per seat. Or $39 / seat / year (save ~19%). Enterprise, with packaged features, comes later.
pricing.seatNote: A seat is one active machine or service identity, not a person — billed only if active on 3+ days in a month. CI and ephemeral runners don't count.

trust.rest: Your LLM traffic flows straight to your provider — we only see counts, never content.
